name: DLL sideload from writable location
kql: DeviceImageLoadEvents | where FileName endswith '.dll' | where FolderPath contains 'Users\\' or FolderPath contains 'Temp' | where InitiatingProcessFileName == 'svchost.exe' and FolderPath not contains 'System32'
tuning: DLLs from user-writable dirs into system binaries = sideload.
